name: Vitest on File Change
description: Automatically runs related Vitest tests after a source file is modified, providing immediate test feedback
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run related Vitest tests after file change
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Skip test files themselves
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(test|spec)\. ]]; then exit 0; fi
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/vitest.config.ts" || -f "$ROOT/vitest.config.js" || -f "$ROOT/vite.config.ts" ]]; then
    BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//')
    TEST_FILE=$(find "$ROOT/src" -name "${BASENAME}.test.*" -o -name "${BASENAME}.spec.*" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -n "$TEST_FILE" ]]; then
      echo "Running tests for $BASENAME..."
      cd "$ROOT" && npx vitest run "$TEST_FILE" --reporter=verbose 2>/dev/null | tail -5
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
